presets.name: executor
presets.description: Execute-shaped tasks — bounded, mechanical, fully specified: apply a patch, rename a symbol, add obvious tests, fix lint. Give the worker a tight work order. Any judgment call → implementer; behavior crossing a seam → integrator.

presets.name: curator
presets.tagline: an explicitly enumerated set of finished artifacts retired without collateral change
presets.description: Retirement-shaped tasks — remove or settle an explicitly enumerated, proven-finished set of artifacts and their direct references. Does not decide what is stale: missing proof or an uncertain owner, consumer, or deletion scope stops for escalation. Opportunistic cleanup, refactoring, and unrelated modernization are out of scope.

presets.name: implementer
presets.tagline: a working feature or fix inside existing patterns
presets.description: Implement-shaped tasks — bounded or mid-size work inside known patterns, with a tight work order. Ambiguous cross-seam debugging → integrator; choosing a new shape → designer.

presets.name: integrator
presets.tagline: a working change across seams, with the map of what moved
presets.description: Integrate-shaped tasks — changes across consequential behavioral seams, ambiguous debugging, refactors with behavior at stake. Choosing a new design shape rather than working within one → designer.

presets.name: designer
presets.tagline: a decision with trade-offs, not code
presets.description: Design-shaped tasks — choosing the shape of things: APIs, data models, decomposition, naming that commits the system; small decisions with large blast radius are design, not execute. Produces a DECISION with trade-offs, not code — read-only by design.

presets.name: director
presets.tagline: independent work reconciled into one evidence-backed result
presets.description: Director-shaped work — genuinely independent pieces whose parallel execution materially shortens delivery and whose seams must be designed, staffed, and reconciled. Coordinates only: freshly admits each child, consumes results, may run one existing integrated aggregate check, makes the final judgment, and returns one result; never executes worker subtasks. Atomic or tightly coupled work → a worker role.

presets.name: team-lead
presets.tagline: one workstream reconciled into a single evidence-backed result
presets.description: Team-lead orchestration — first rung of the scope ladder: coordinate ONE workstream (a bounded tree of directly staffed children) to a single reconciled, evidence-backed result. Sees its own workstream in full and the program above only as constraints. Several workstreams → program; the whole board → portfolio.

presets.name: program
presets.tagline: several workstreams reconciled into one program outcome, with the cross-workstream seam map
presets.description: Program orchestration — middle rung of the scope ladder: coordinate SEVERAL workstreams toward one program goal; owns the seams between workstreams and their sequencing, never any lane's interior. One workstream → team-lead; the whole board → portfolio.

presets.name: portfolio
presets.tagline: the board held coherent — programs reconciled into one portfolio outcome
presets.description: Portfolio orchestration — top rung of the scope ladder: hold the whole board; coordinate programs, own cross-program seams and priorities, below only a human owner. Reasons in programs and their seams, never lane detail.

presets.name: scout
presets.description: Scout work — locate, map, gather: where is X, what calls Y, sweep a codebase or the web for sources. Read-only, low-cost fan-out unit; spawn several in parallel. Gathers and reports without deep synthesis. Deep analysis or root-cause → analyst; cutting-edge inquiry → scientist.

presets.name: analyst
presets.description: Analysis work — how a system actually works, why it behaves as it does, root-cause, or grounding a design against real behavior. Read-only, depth over breadth; honest-zero findings are valid. Falls back to explicitly static-only analysis, naming unobserved behavior, when no read-only execution surface exists. Produces UNDERSTANDING — not a disposition (→ reviewer), a decision (→ designer), or a change (→ integrator); mere location/gathering → scout. Fan out when independently traceable mechanisms warrant separate evidence trails; keep tightly coupled traces together regardless of subsystem count.

presets.name: guardian
presets.tagline: a bounded read-only account of what must not change
presets.description: Preservation-shaped work — inspect a named live, shared, or immutable boundary and report the observed invariants, ownership, and uncertainty without altering it. Does not review a supplied change (→ reviewer), explain an arbitrary mechanism (→ analyst), or retire finished artifacts (→ curator).

presets.name: reviewer
presets.tagline: one supplied artifact reviewed across multiple criteria, with prioritized findings and a disposition
presets.description: Artifact review — one supplied artifact or change in; evidence-backed prioritized findings plus accept, changes-required, or cannot-assess out. Read-only; never fixes or redesigns. Explicit assurance of one claim → verifier; ranking alternatives → judge; mechanism explanation → analyst.

presets.name: verifier
presets.tagline: one claim in, one adversarial verdict out
presets.description: Explicit-user-request-only adversarial verification of one specific claim — "is this bug real", "does this fix actually hold", "try to refute this". Ordinary uncertainty never authorizes this role. Ranking alternatives → judge; multi-criterion review of one artifact → reviewer.

presets.name: judge
presets.tagline: competing alternatives in, a ranked decision out
presets.description: Rubric-backed ranking of two or more supplied alternatives — scores, a winner, and what to graft from runners-up. Does not verify a single claim (→ verifier) or invent the candidate set (→ designer). Read-only.

presets.name: scientist
presets.tagline: hypotheses, discriminating experiments, and evidence-bounded analysis
presets.description: Research-grade inquiry — open solution class, novel method, answer genuinely unknown. Frames competing hypotheses and discriminating experiments; invokes existing non-mutating probes only, never authors code or apparatus (hand that to an authoring role). Source gathering → scout; ordinary root-cause → analyst. Research is a function, not a task grade.

presets.name: experimenter
presets.tagline: a disposable rig that answers one stated question
presets.description: Experiment-shaped work — author and run a narrowly scoped disposable script, fixture, or apparatus for a stated hypothesis, then remove it unless the brief explicitly retains it. Produces observations and the retained-or-removed disposition, never an unrequested production feature. Hypothesis selection → scientist; a durable product change → implementer or integrator.
